plugin.name: Chakra_Cooldown
plugin.author: Claude / modified by ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Shows a small cockpit-style indicator light for Chakra cooldown status
plugin.description:
USAGE:
chakra show : show the cooldown window chakra hide : hide the cooldown window
Automatically catches: You close your eyes and concentrate, and suddenly appear healthier. -> light becomes unlit / cooldown
You can use Chakra again. -> light becomes lit / ready
Default theme preserves the original red/green states. Amber and Green themes use lit/unlit lamps in the selected phosphor colour.
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

trigger.match: ^You close your eyes and concentrate, and suddenly appear healthier\.$

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
Win = GetPluginID()
-- Narrower than before - previous version's bezel math overflowed -- the window edges since it didn't account for the bezel padding -- extending OUTWARD beyond the lamp's own diameter. WINDOW_WIDTH = 140 WINDOW_HEIGHT = 155 TITLE_HEIGHT = 18 TITLE_FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console" TITLE_FONT_SIZE = 9 LIGHT_MARGIN = 10
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHARED UI THEMES --------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "chakra"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
default = { background = "#000000", border = "#E8E8E8", title_bar = "#202020", title_text = "#D4D0C8", bezel_fill = "#2A2A2A", bezel_border = "#000000",
ready_outer = "#0D4D1A", ready_middle = "#1F9E3D", ready_inner = "#4DFF6E", ready_highlight = "#CFFFD9",
cooldown_outer = "#4D0D0D", cooldown_middle = "#9E1F1F", cooldown_inner = "#FF4D4D", cooldown_highlight = "#FFD9D9" },
amber = { background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title_text = "#FFB347", bezel_fill = "#24160B", bezel_border = "#050301",
ready_outer = "#6B3308", ready_middle = "#C66A12", ready_inner = "#FF9D26", ready_highlight = "#FFE0A3",
cooldown_outer = "#201207", cooldown_middle = "#35200D", cooldown_inner = "#4A2A0D", cooldown_highlight = "#69401B" },
green = { background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title_text = "#9AFF82", bezel_fill = "#102010", bezel_border = "#000500",
ready_outer = "#0D4D1A", ready_middle = "#1F9E3D", ready_inner = "#4DFF6E", ready_highlight = "#CFFFD9",
cooldown_outer = "#061507", cooldown_middle = "#0B2910", cooldown_inner = "#123B17", cooldown_highlight = "#20582A" } }
function LoadTheme()
local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[theme] then theme = "default" end
local T = THEMES[theme]
BACKGROUND_COLOUR = ThemeColour("background", T.background) BORDER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("border", T.border) TITLE_BAR_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar) TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_text", T.title_text)
BEZEL_FILL = ThemeColour("bezel_fill", T.bezel_fill) BEZEL_BORDER = ThemeColour("bezel_border", T.bezel_border)
READY_OUTER = ThemeColour("ready_outer", T.ready_outer) READY_MIDDLE = ThemeColour("ready_middle", T.ready_middle) READY_INNER = ThemeColour("ready_inner", T.ready_inner) READY_HIGHLIGHT = ThemeColour("ready_highlight", T.ready_highlight)
COOLDOWN_OUTER = ThemeColour("cooldown_outer", T.cooldown_outer) COOLDOWN_MIDDLE = ThemeColour("cooldown_middle", T.cooldown_middle) COOLDOWN_INNER = ThemeColour("cooldown_inner", T.cooldown_inner) COOLDOWN_HIGHLIGHT = ThemeColour("cooldown_highlight", T.cooldown_highlight) end
LoadTheme()
windowinfo = ""
-- persisted across sessions - assume ready to start unless we've seen otherwise chakraReady = GetVariable("chakraReady") if chakraReady == nil then chakraReady = true else chakraReady = (chakraReady == "true") end
function UseChakra( flags, hotspot_id )
Send("use punchart chakra") end
function OnPluginInstall() LoadTheme()
check(WindowCreate(Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, 0, 0, BACKGROUND_COLOUR)) check(WindowFont(Win, "title"..Win, TITLE_FONT_NAME, TITLE_FONT_SIZE, true))
windowinfo = movewindow.install(Win, miniwin.pos_top_right, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true) WindowCreate(Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, BACKGROUND_COLOUR)
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT )
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "chakra_use", 0, TITLE_HEIGHT, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, "", "", "", "", "UseChakra", "Use Chakra", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0 )
Redraw_Window() WindowShow(Win, true) end
function OnPluginSaveState() movewindow.save_state(Win) SetVariable("chakraReady", tostring(chakraReady)) end
function OnPluginEnable() LoadTheme() Redraw_Window() WindowShow(Win, true) end
function OnPluginDisable() WindowShow(Win, false) end
-- Draws the lamp as three concentric flat circles (dark -> bright) -- to fake a soft radial glow, plus a small pale highlight offset -- toward the upper-left for a glossy, physical-light look. function DrawLamp(left, top, right, bottom, outerColour, middleColour, innerColour, highlightColour)
local width = right - left local height = bottom - top
WindowCircleOp(Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, left, top, right, bottom, outerColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0, outerColour, miniwin.brush_solid)
local midInset = width * 0.18 WindowCircleOp(Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, left + midInset, top + midInset, right - midInset, bottom - midInset, middleColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0, middleColour, miniwin.brush_solid)
local innerInset = width * 0.38 WindowCircleOp(Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, left + innerInset, top + innerInset, right - innerInset, bottom - innerInset, innerColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0, innerColour, miniwin.brush_solid)
local hlDiameter = width * 0.26 local hlLeft = left + (width * 0.15) local hlTop = top + (height * 0.13) WindowCircleOp(Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, hlLeft, hlTop, hlLeft + hlDiameter, hlTop + hlDiameter, highlightColour, miniwin.pen_null, 0, highlightColour, miniwin.brush_solid)
end
function Redraw_Window() WindowRectOp(Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR) WindowRectOp(Win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, 0, 0, BORDER_COLOUR)
-- title bar WindowRectOp(Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WINDOW_WIDTH, TITLE_HEIGHT, TITLE_BAR_COLOUR) WindowText(Win, "title"..Win, "CHAKRA", 8, 3, 0, 0, TITLE_TEXT_COLOUR, false)
-- Solve for a lamp diameter such that the BEZEL (lamp + padding -- on every side) fits within the available space - the previous -- version only checked the lamp itself, so the bezel padding -- pushed past the window edges. local availableWidth = WINDOW_WIDTH - (LIGHT_MARGIN * 2) local availableHeight = WINDOW_HEIGHT - TITLE_HEIGHT - (LIGHT_MARGIN * 2) local availableSpace = math.min(availableWidth, availableHeight)
local bezelFactor = 0.15 -- bezel padding as a fraction of lamp diameter local diameter = availableSpace / (1 + (bezelFactor * 2))
local lampLeft = (WINDOW_WIDTH - diameter) / 2 local lampTop = TITLE_HEIGHT + ((WINDOW_HEIGHT - TITLE_HEIGHT - diameter) / 2) local lampRight = lampLeft + diameter local lampBottom = lampTop + diameter
local bezelPad = diameter * bezelFactor
WindowCircleOp(Win, miniwin.circle_ellipse, lampLeft - bezelPad, lampTop - bezelPad, lampRight + bezelPad, lampBottom + bezelPad, BEZEL_BORDER, miniwin.pen_solid, 1, BEZEL_FILL, miniwin.brush_solid)
if chakraReady then DrawLamp(lampLeft, lampTop, lampRight, lampBottom, READY_OUTER, READY_MIDDLE, READY_INNER, READY_HIGHLIGHT) else DrawLamp(lampLeft, lampTop, lampRight, lampBottom, COOLDOWN_OUTER, COOLDOWN_MIDDLE, COOLDOWN_INNER, COOLDOWN_HIGHLIGHT) end
Redraw() end
function ChakraUsed(name, line, wildcards) chakraReady = false Redraw_Window() end
function ChakraReady(name, line, wildcards) chakraReady = true Redraw_Window() end
function chakra_show(name, line, wildcards) WindowShow(Win, true) ColourNote("yellow", "", "Chakra window shown. Type 'chakra hide' to hide it.") end
function chakra_hide(name, line, wildcards) WindowShow(Win, false) ColourNote("yellow", "", "Chakra window hidden. Type 'chakra show' to see it again.") end
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEME BROADCAST --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme() Redraw_Window() end
